mechanism: Echinacea may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP1A2, potentially increasing amitriptyline plasma concentrations and anticholinergic effects; additive immunostimulation and possible serotonergic activity interactions.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic symptoms (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation) and tricyclic toxicity; consider dose adjustment if needed; counsel patient on concurrent use risks.
